diamond-cell.name: diamond cell (Voronoi cell of the diamond pattern; classically the triakis truncated tetrahedron)
diamond-cell.scale: cube of the diamond pattern = 4 (bond length √3)

keyed-TO.name: keyed truncated octahedron (a DICTO design study shape; name to be given by DICTO)
keyed-TO.scale: bcc lattice points 2Z³ ∪ 2Z³+(1,1,1); truncated octahedron edge 0.707107; pyramid height h (shown h = 0.5)
keyed-TO.four_round_one: yes: four pieces round one, each across a bump hexagon, a plain translate (its dent takes the bump)
keyed-TO.four_meeting_at_a_point: at its 24 truncated-octahedron corners (see cells_meeting_at_corners; the 8 pyramid apexes are where 2 meet)
